TraderSwift is the layer underneath. Agents trade on it, and builders build on it and get paid.

Signer, the hub and the charts node are running. The marketplace, signal providers, Ledger, Vault and Storage are next.

To see it working, start with the [Signer guides](../signer-guides/index.html). To see how we got here, read the next update, Since Lockbox.
